subject: Private deployment pricing and support tiers — CloudNova inquiry
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@cloudnova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing and support tiers

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking my note last week — following up here from CloudNova (we're the health-tech platform you demoed for last month). Procurement and engineering want a clearer view of commercials for a private VPC/on-prem deployment. Specifically:  

- Licensing: one-time on-prem license vs subscription; do you provide both? Any guidance on amortization for our CFO.
- Platform fee: how is the platform fee charged (monthly % of committed capacity, flat per-seat, or blended)? Are there caps for large GPU footprints?
- Support tiers: we need a 24/7 on-call option with guaranteed P1 response and optional engineering time for monthly maintenance windows. Please list typical SLA buckets and associated price deltas.
- Multi-year/volume discount: we're planning a 3-year commit across multiple sites; what discount bands and service credits (if any) do you offer?

We'd like a short, written pricing summary we can send to our CFO and procurement. If you can attach a sample SOW or SKU matrix, that would help accelerate. Also happy to hop on a quick 30-minute call next week.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Director, Procurement — CloudNova
[CloudNova Inc.]

Attachment: CloudNova-RFP-reqs.pdf (referenced)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and support tiers

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. I've looped in Marissa (commercials) and Grace (support/ops) so we can give a consolidated response. Quick summary up front, then we'll attach a SKU matrix + sample SOW: 

- Licensing: we offer both perpetual on-prem licenses (one-time) with an annual maintenance fee, and multi-year subscription (annual billing). CFO teams typically amortize perpetual licenses over 3–5 years; we provide an amortization worksheet on request.
- Platform fee: typically a monthly platform fee based on committed vGPU capacity banding. For larger footprints we cap the marginal platform fee after a threshold and offer a blended effective rate.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours), Premium (24/7 P1 within 1 hour), and Enterprise (Premium + retained engineering hours + quarterly on-site/remote tuning). I'll let Grace post the example SLAs and response windows.
- Discounting: we generally provide volume and multi-year discounts and can include service credits for migration assistance. For a 3-year, multi-site commit we can propose a blended discount + one-time migration credit.

Next steps: we'll prepare a short commercial options sheet — two SKUs (subscription vs perpetual) and two support bands (Premium, Enterprise) + an optional migration credit line. Can we tentatively schedule 30 minutes on Tue 5/19 or Wed 5/20?

Regards,
Karthik
Senior Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: placeholder — will send SKU matrix and sample SOW shortly]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: CloudNova pricing ask (see external thread)

Marissa / Grace — please see Priya's note above. I want two concrete options to present: a subscription-first path and a perpetual + maintenance path. Requirements:

1) SKU matrix: break out vGPU bands (small/med/large), platform fee per band, and marginal cap after X units. Include a line item for "migration assistance" as a creditable one-time item.
2) Support pricing: show Standard / Premium / Enterprise with SLA response times (P1/P2/P3) and how many retained engineering hours come with Enterprise. Add optional monthly "ops hour" block purchase pricing.
3) Multi-year discounting: show 1yr/2yr/3yr bands and sample blended discount for a 3yr commit across 3 sites (assume 150 vGPU aggregate).
4) CFO-friendly note: provide amortization example for perpetual license (3 & 5 year) and language around capital vs operating treatment.

Can you draft the SKU spreadsheet and a 1-page SOW blurb? I want to email Priya a clean proposal by EOD Mon 5/18 PST. I'm okay to price conservatively — aim to win the deal but don't pre-commit migration credits beyond 10% of first-year spend without approval.

Karthik

[Internal comment: Marissa — if we can include a 6-week onboarding package (engineering ramp + runbook) as a value-add that would be favorable. Grace — confirm whether 24/7 P1 with 1-hr target requires a retained engineer or we can do on-call rotations.]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and support tiers

Hi Priya — thanks for the patience. Attached are two concise options and a sample SOW for CloudNova's internal review:  

Option A — Subscription (recommended for flexibility)
- 36-month subscription, committed 150 vGPU aggregate across 3 sites
- Monthly platform fee: banded (see attachment VPC_SKU_matrix.xlsx). Effective blended platform fee = $1,200/vGPU-month (after blended discount).
- Support: Enterprise tier included (24/7 P1, 1-hr response SLA) with 40 retained engineering hours / month.
- Migration assistance: one-time credit = 7% of year-1 committed spend (applied as invoice credit).

Option B — Perpetual license + maintenance
- Perpetual license with annual maintenance at 22% of license value.
- Example amortization: we included both 3-yr and 5-yr amortization schedules in the worksheet.
- Support: Premium (24/7 P1 with 4-hr response) available; Enterprise upgrade is available for +30% of maintenance cost.

Additional notes:
- We've capped marginal platform fee after 200 vGPU at a reduced incremental rate.
- If CloudNova signs the 36-month subscription and executes the SOW by 2026-06-30 we can increase the migration credit to 10% and provide a complimentary 6-week onboarding package (engineering ramp + runbook).

I attached: VPC_SKU_matrix.xlsx and CloudNova-SOW-v2.pdf. Please let me know a preferred time for a 30-minute commercial review — Karthik suggested Tue 5/19 or Wed 5/20.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudNova-SOW-v2.pdf (28 KB); VPC_SKU_matrix.xlsx (12 KB)
